title: Mtaalamu mzuri wa nywele ni mshirika wa mtindo wako na husema hapana inapohitajika
label: Mshirika wa mtindo wa nywele

text.At my salon now, the hairdresser remembe: Katika saluni ninayoenda sasa, mtengeneza nywele hukumbuka mtindo ninaoutaka.
text.My hairstyle now is kind of like Himmel: Mtindo wangu wa sasa unafanana kidogo na Himmel wa “Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End.”
text.But it is a little too straight, so I wa: Lakini umenyooka kidogo kupita kiasi, kwa hiyo nataka nywele za pembeni zipinde kwa upole na kuanguka vizuri.
text.We are building that goal little by litt: Mimi na mtengeneza nywele wangu tunafikia lengo hilo hatua kwa hatua.
text.Hair grows by itself even if I do nothin: Nywele hukua zenyewe hata nisipofanya chochote, kwa hiyo inafurahisha kuhisi: “Leo nimekaribia kidogo mtindo ninaoutaka.”
text.Also, even when I say, \"Please cut here: Hata nikisema “Tafadhali kata hapa,” hutoa maoni yake ya kweli: “Nikikata hapo, zitakua kwa namna ya ajabu.”
text.They do not just go along with everythin: Hakubali kila kitu tu. Inapohitajika kusema hapana, husema hapana.
text.The difference between a 1,000-yen hairc: Tofauti kati ya kunyoa nywele kwa yen 1,000 na kwa zaidi ya yen 5,000
